prior_evidence_policy: Reuse only the exact covered cases with verified provenance and unchanged behavior; never infer full workspace or tool coverage. No prior evidence is silently marked as current full-surface qualification.

additional_areas.scope: Launch, foreground/control banner, recovery, missing runtime, crash/error messages
New, open, save, save-as, rename, dirty/close behavior, import/export menus, overwrite dialogs
Selection, visibility, context menus, feature edit/rename/delete/reorder/rollback, Undo/Redo
Fit, zoom/wheel, pan/orbit, orientation dial, hover, geometry/annotation picking, keyboard shortcuts
Settings, units, theme, locale, defaults, persistence and readable labels
Expand each command into modes, fields, selections, apply/cancel, validation and retained editing
Body appearance, materials, component/instance names, visibility, placements and named views
Sheet/view/dimension/annotation/table editing, paper navigation, selection, PDF/print layouts
Machines/tools/setups/operations/WCS, geometry selection, simulation/playback, reports and NC export
Print settings/modifiers/layouts, preflight, portable exports, supported slicer handoffs and errors
Narrow/wide layouts, clipping/overlap, focus/tab/escape/enter, feedback, empty/disabled/error states
Help/scripts/MCP status/presentation surfaces; restrictions remain explicit and no replay is authorized

mcp.phase_gate: UI inventory complete; every UI case passed or explicitly excluded by the user, with no unresolved in-scope failures
mcp.inventory_source: read-only cad_list_all_tools planning snapshot, including unadvertised tools
